catalog.emptySource: This source offers no extensions (no folders with index.ts and no <name>@<version> tags).

check.upToDate: All installed extensions are up to date

notify.stillLoading: {name} is installed and still loading (installing dependencies); check back shortly

includePrereleases.title: Include prereleases

sources.deleteMessage: Its local mirror is deleted. Sources with installed extensions cannot be deleted.

sources.name: Name

sources.urlHint: SSH (uses the server's SSH keys), HTTPS, or a local path.

status.localHint: A hand-placed folder with this name exists; the hub does not overwrite it
